before.requirement: Exercise gamma-enabled RGBA8 LUT computation and pixel lookup through the context LUT.
before.reason: The old decoder had a gamma-guarded LUT allocation and lookup, but the fixed harness passed only TRNS.

after.requirement: Exercise gamma-enabled RGBA8 LUT computation and pixel lookup through the rewritten local LUT.
after.reason: The new local LUT and pixel lookup remain behind the same gamma flag, which the fixed harness does not pass.

claims.reason: Both versions require GAMA bit 2 to execute gamma LUT processing. The same old harness supplies TRNS bit 1 in its sole decode call, so the replacement of the LUT implementation did not introduce the coverage constraint.
